# Privacy & Security

> Manage active sessions, devices, and multi-factor authentication for your Zencoder account.

The Privacy & Security page gives you control over your account security — active sessions, device management, and multi-factor authentication.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/forgoodaiinc/Y_SEC3iavYl5Qnon/images/admin/admin-privacy-security.jpg?fit=max&auto=format&n=Y_SEC3iavYl5Qnon&q=85&s=62248ea58688325980f1116ec5774477" alt="Privacy & Security page showing active sessions and multi-factor authentication options" style={{ borderRadius: '12px', marginTop: '8px', marginBottom: '16px' }} width="1260" height="720" data-path="images/admin/admin-privacy-security.jpg" />

## Sessions

View all devices currently signed in to your Zencoder account. Each session shows:

| Field | Description |
| - | - |
| **Browser & OS** | The browser and operating system (e.g., Chrome on macOS) |
| **Location** | Approximate location based on IP address |
| **This device** | Badge indicating your current active session |

You can revoke any session to sign out that device immediately.

## Security

### Multi-Factor Authentication

Enable MFA to add an extra verification step when signing in. Once enabled, you'll need to provide a second factor (authenticator app or security key) in addition to your password.

<Tip>
  Enabling MFA is recommended for all accounts, especially those with Admin or Manager roles.
</Tip>
